title: The Bolden photograph again and wishing for a record
summary: She shows Willie's picture, says the one with Bolden on Perdido Street is lost, and all regret there is no recording of him.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans

He was talking about how nice he could play. I said, oh yeah. That's what they're talking about. Yeah. That's him, man. That's all I got. That's a picture of him. I got my specs.
